# Memmy v1.2.9

## Unreleased development baseline

This pending version includes the released Memmy v1.2.6 baseline from main commit 2c4425ca117d6077aff5346cd9314859e580c0e9 through the manually requested main synchronization.

- Root, Agent, Desktop, Backend and native version metadata are aligned to 1.2.9.
- Memory remains independently versioned at 2.1.7.
- The v1.2.6 fixes and behavior are documented in [the v1.2.6 release notes](v1.2.6.md).

The scope of additional changes for this version remains under development. These notes must be completed and reviewed against the final release candidate before publication.
